question: Does anthropics/jacobian-lens at the registered commit provide an official readout / kurtosis path? (adjudication ladder rung A-1)

package.note: the config.yaml published with the external lenses cites the repo as github.com/anthropics/jlens; that name returns 404 and the actual repository is anthropics/jacobian-lens, which is the one the authority pins

how_this_was_established.1_installed_wheel: every .py file in the installed package was searched for kurt, moment, excess, skew and scipy.stats
how_this_was_established.3_every_definition: every def and class in every module was listed
how_this_was_established.4_repository_tree: the repository tree at the registered commit was listed via the GitHub API, to catch anything present in the repo but absent from the wheel
how_this_was_established.5_documentation: README.md, walkthrough.ipynb, data/experiments/README.md and data/evaluations/README.md were fetched at the registered commit and searched

readout_path_that_is_provided.returns: raw logits, shape [n_positions, vocab_size]; no softmax anywhere in the call
readout_path_that_is_provided.logit_lens_baseline: the same function with use_jacobian=False, guarded at line 211

readout_path_that_is_provided.code: residual = activations[layer][0, start:].float(); if layer in lens.jacobians: residual = lens.transport(residual, layer); return model.unembed(residual).float().detach()
readout_path_that_is_provided.significance: this is the library's own ANALYSIS readout, and it agrees exactly with apply(): raw logits, no softmax, no extra normalisation

the_only_readout_hits_were: jlens/data/slice_vis.html, a CSS class name for a UI element

what_this_means_for_the_ladder.the_readout_is_not_in_dispute: EQ1 already used apply() and the raw-logit readout, and the library's own analysis code confirms that path independently. Nothing about EQ1's readout path is contradicted here.
what_this_means_for_the_ladder.what_is_in_dispute_is_untouched_by_A1: the AXIS along which excess kurtosis is taken. The library computes no moments at all, so adopting 'the official readout path' leaves the V-versus-D question exactly where it was.
what_this_means_for_the_ladder.conclusion: A-1 is answered honestly as: readout PROVIDED, kurtosis NOT PROVIDED. Because A-1 can only end adjudication if it resolves the convention, and it does not, adjudication proceeds to A-2.

claim_ceiling: A source-code finding. It licenses no claim of any kind.
